title: Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.35926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized h

translated_title: 规范损失景观导航：一种基于轨迹的增量学习遗忘缓解方法
translated_abstract: 持续学习模型在非平稳数据分布上进行顺序训练时会遭受灾难性遗忘。以往，这一问题主要通过权重正则化来解决。虽然预条件梯度为缓解遗忘提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但现有方法是短视的（仅关注局部）。相反，标准的正则化方法采用僵化的标量欧几里得惩罚，完全忽略了参数空间底层的黎曼几何。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了TMLN（轨迹调制景观导航），这是一种规范化的导航策略，将持续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题。TMLN利用内存高效的对角经验Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）来定义局部化的黎曼流形。为了补偿对角近似的空间局限性，TMLN使用归一化的历史梯度信息动态调制预条件器（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出TMLN方法，将持续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，利用对角Fisher信息矩阵构建局部黎曼流形，并通过基于轨迹的预条件器动态调制来缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes TMLN, which formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape, using a diagonal empirical FIM to define a localized Riemannian manifold and dynamically modulating a preconditioner via trajectory information to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
